meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 扫描项目代码，从结构、一致性、类型、测试等9个维度查找技术债务，输出一份包含严重级别、预估修复工时和优先修复项的报告文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行技术债务审计、代码库健康检查、架构评审等时触发，或说出“tech debt”、“code health”等关键词时。

say.text: 请审计这个项目的技术债务。
say.note: 会扫描并生成审计报告。

say.text: 检查代码库健康状况，列出问题。
say.note: 输出含严重度和修复建议的报告。

say.text: 分析架构和代码质量，给出优先修复项。

howto.what_en: Scans the codebase across 9 dimensions (structure, consistency, types, tests, etc.) for technical debt, then produces a report with severity, estimated effort, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked for a technical debt audit, codebase health check, or architecture review, or when mentioning keywords like "tech debt" or "code health".

say_en.text: Audit this project for technical debt.
say_en.note: Scans and generates an audit report.

say_en.text: Check the codebase health and list issues.
say_en.note: Outputs a report with severity and fixes.
